**Assistant Manager \- AI Delivery Product**
============================================

Date: Sep 21, 2026
Location:
Hyderabad, IN


Requisition ID: 23859
Description:
**About Firstsource:** Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP\-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper\-focused, domain\-centered teams and cutting\-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real\-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future\-focused outcomes.


**Job Brief**


We are seeking a highly experienced and hands\-on Lead AI Engineer to drive the design, development, and delivery of enterprise\-scale AI products. This role combines technical leadership with deep engineering expertise, requiring active involvement in product feature architecture, full\-stack application development, AI/ML model integration, code reviews, release management, and engineering best practices within our AI Product Engineering team.


The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Cloud Technologies, and modern full\-stack development, with a proven ability to lead technical teams while remaining actively engaged in coding. They should be passionate about building scalable, production\-ready AI products, mentoring engineers, establishing technical standards, and collaborating with Product Managers and cross\-functional teams to transform product requirements into robust, high\-performance AI\-powered product features.


**Mandatory Technical Skills**


* 4 to 6\+ years of hands\-on software development experience with strong coding expertise.
* Strong programming experience in Python (Mandatory).
* Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, AI Agents, and Agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with Vector Databases and Enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, or equivalent.
* Proven experience in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise\-grade applications.
* Strong expertise in Full Stack Development: Backend (Python, FastAPI, Flask, Django) and Frontend (React.js, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3\).
* Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs and Microservices.
* Strong understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID Principles, Design Patterns, and Domain\-Driven Design (DDD).
* Hands\-on experience building, training, fine\-tuning, and deploying Machine Learning models.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and XGBoost.
* Experience deploying AI/ML solutions into production environments and implementing MLOps practices.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure Cloud Platforms (Mandatory).
* Experience with cloud\-native development, containerization, and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event\-driven architecture, scalability, performance optimization, and security best practices.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

**Roles and Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable full\-stack applications using Python and modern front\-end frameworks.
* Build and deploy Machine Learning and AI\-powered solutions for enterprise use cases.
* Actively contribute to coding, code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization activities.
* Develop and maintain REST APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native applications.
* Design scalable, secure, and maintainable software architectures following industry best practices.
* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and MLOps processes.
* Deploy, monitor, and optimize applications and ML models on AWS and/or Azure.
* Ensure high standards of code quality through automated testing, peer reviews, and engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers.
* Drive continuous improvement in architecture, development processes, security, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Mentor and guide team members on technical design, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to enhance products and platforms.
* Work in Agile teams and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and successful delivery of project milestones.
* Own and evolve specific modules/features within Firstsource's AI product suite, maintaining a technical backlog in partnership with Product Management.
* Conduct usability, performance, and scalability testing across product releases and drive iterative improvements based on internal and client feedback loops.
* Support release planning, versioning, and product documentation for engineering and support teams.

**Experience \& Education**


* 4\-6\+ years of overall experience.
* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an Engineering discipline.
* **️ Disclaimer:** Firstsource follows a fair, transparent, and merit\-based hiring process. We never ask for money at any stage. Beware of fraudulent offers and always verify through our official channels or @firstsource.com email addresses.


Apply now

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I/II
jobs.description:
You will work as part of a collaborative engineering team, contributing to the ongoing development and stability of the AIS platform — supporting insurers, suppliers, police forces and other organisations across the UK and internationally.
  

Our platform makes use of modern AWS infrastructure alongside a proven PHP and MySQL technology stack, with a dynamic Angular front end, delivering reliable and scalable solutions to the insurance ecosystem.
  

You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from design and development through to deployment and operational support, working closely with engineers, product managers and stakeholders to deliver high\-quality outcomes.
  

This role is ideal for developers who take pride in well\-maintained, production\-grade software, enjoy solving real\-world problems, and want to contribute meaningfully to a platform that matters.


  
What You'll Be Working On
  

The AIS platform supports multiple products used across the UK insurance market, and your work will directly contribute to keeping those products reliable, performant and evolving to meet customer needs.
  

You will work with technologies including:
  

* PHP\-based back\-end services and APIs
* Angular front\-end applications
* MySQL databases
* AWS cloud infrastructure
* RESTful APIs and third\-party integrations
* CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments

The work you deliver will help insurers process claims faster, improve decision making and deliver better outcomes for their customers.
  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

* Maintain, enhance and develop features within the AIS platform
* Build and support PHP back\-end services and RESTful APIs
* Develop and maintain Angular front\-end interfaces
* Design and optimise MySQL database schemas, queries and stored procedures
* Investigate and resolve bugs, performance issues and production incidents
* Contribute to the design and evolution of platform architecture and shared services
* Work within Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand\-ups and retrospectives
* Collaborate with Product Managers to refine requirements, estimate work and deliver features iteratively
* Implement and maintain automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes
* Provide third\-level technical support where required
* Produce and maintain technical documentation
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices, tooling and platform reliability

  
Qualifications
  

  

Essential Requirements
  

* 3\+ years professional experience building and maintaining commercial software systems
* Strong experience developing server\-side applications using PHP (Laravel, Symfony or similar frameworks preferred)
* Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and JSON\-based integrations
* Experience working with MySQL, including schema design, query optimisation and performance tuning
* Front\-end development experience with Angular
* Experience building or deploying applications on AWS cloud infrastructure
* Experience using Git or modern source control systems
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments
* A methodical approach to problem solving, debugging and production support
* A passion for technology and a desire to continuously learn and improve

Highly Desirable
  

* Experience working with AWS serverless services (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway)
* Experience working within Agile / Scrum development environments
* Knowledge of event\-driven architecture or message bus technologies
* Experience implementing Test\-Driven Development (TDD)
* Understanding of software design patterns and clean architecture principles
* Familiarity with AI development tools or AI\-assisted engineering workflows
* Experience working within the insurance or financial services industry

  

  

What We're Looking For
  

We're looking for a well\-rounded developer who is as comfortable maintaining and improving existing systems as they are building new features. You should be confident working across the full stack — PHP back\-end services, MySQL databases and Angular front ends — and be someone who takes ownership of the quality and reliability of the software they deliver.
  

A background in, or enthusiasm for, the insurance sector would be a bonus, though it is not essential.
  
**Our People, Our Culture**

For more than 50 years, Verisk has helped property and casualty insurers make smarter decisions about risk through AI\-powered risk modeling, advanced analytics, and technology solutions spanning the entire policy lifecycle. We are a leading strategic data, analytics, and technology partner to the global insurance industry, guided by core values of learning, caring, and results while maintaining the highest ethical standards as stewards of the industry's most comprehensive datasets. Learn more about Verisk and what we are doing within the insurance industry.


For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best\-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Forecasting
jobs.description:
**About the Team:**
-------------------



The Workforce Demand Forecasting team is part of Global Support and Integrity Operations. We help DoorDash deliver reliable, efficient, and high quality support by translating business activity into demand forecasts and actionable planning insights.



Our work informs customer experience, workforce investment, operational readiness, and cost. We partner with Workforce Management, Operations, Finance, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Product, and Engineering to improve forecast accuracy, strengthen planning decisions, and build scalable operating mechanisms.



The team supports a broad set of global support workstreams. Our goal is to provide leaders with the forecasts, insights, and decision frameworks needed to balance service, customer experience, and cost.


**About the Role:**
-------------------



We are seeking an Associate Manager to lead a defined set of Forecasting workstreams and strengthen the team's operating model.



This role goes beyond forecast production. You will own workstream performance from end to end, including forecast quality, prioritization, business readiness, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement. FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

jobs.description:
**Description \& Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

**Product Management Intern – Growth \& Player Marketing**
**Location: Hyderabad (In office)**
**Duration: 8\- 10 weeks**
**About EA**
 Electronic Arts Inc. is a global leader in interactive entertainment. We develop and deliver games, content and online services across platforms. We have a broad portfolio of brands that span the most popular genres.
   

  

 We exist to Inspire the World to Play. We create extraordinary new game experiences for our millions of players everywhere by bringing together talented people that combine creativity, innovation, and passion. We immerse our employees in an inclusive culture and provide opportunities for learning and leading that allow our employees to do the most impactful and rewarding work of their careers.
   

  

 Join us in driving the next revolution in games.
   

  

**Help Us Create Games Players Love To Talk About**
 EA is looking for a Product Management Intern who is curious about players, data, culture, storytelling, and what makes a game stand out. The intern will report to a PM/ SPM and work closely with game designers, developers, artists, analysts, user researchers, and marketing teams to help us understand our audiences, shape how we communicate with players, and support campaigns that introduce more people to our games and encourage existing players to keep coming back.
   

  

 In this role, the intern will support the development and improvement of game features, live events, progression systems, monetization experiences, and player journeys. It will use a combination of player feedback, market research, game data, and structured problem\-solving to identify opportunities and help the team make better product decisions.
   

  

 This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys games, understands what makes players return to them, and wants to learn how successful games are designed, launched, measured, and improved.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product and Creative Collaboration
+ Collaborate with analysts, designers, engineers and artists to gather inputs, scope product requirements and communicate decisions to stakeholders.
+ Support product managers in defining features, events, progression systems, social features, and monetization experiences.
+ Participate in playtests, design reviews, sprint planning, and feature retrospectives.
+ Create product collaterals to document learnings, and support teams in tracking feature scope, development progress \& utilization.

* Campaigns and Game Launches
+ Help develop player communication journeys across push notifications, email, social media, community channels, and in\-game messages.
+ Support the planning and execution of campaigns for new features, events, content updates, and game launches.
+ Help create campaign briefs that define the audience, player insight, message, channels, and success metrics.
+ Contribute ideas for social media content, creator partnerships, in\-game messaging, app\-store promotions, and community activations.
+ Support A/B tests across messages, creative concepts, channels, offers, and audience segments.

* Market Research:
+ Conduct competitor research \& emerging trends to identify growth opportunities and propose product features to game leads.

* Player Insights:
+ Analyze game telemetry data to understand player behavior across areas such as onboarding, progression, retention, engagement, conversion, and monetization.
+ Identify drop\-offs, friction points, and underserved player needs within the game.
+ Understand player persona and expectations based on qualitative data from surveys, app\-store reviews, community channels, customer support, and social media.


**Must Have**
* Interest in games and understanding games as a business
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-moving, cross\-functional environment.


**Good To Have**
* Familiarity with free\-to\-play games, live\-service games, and mobile games, and understanding of game metrics
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or another analytics tool.
* Experience creating surveys, analyzing customer feedback, or conducting user research.
* Experience participating in gaming communities, esports, game jams, fandoms, creator communities, or student clubs.


**What Success Will Look Like**
 During the internship, the intern should be able to:
   

  

* Develop a practical understanding of game development and product management lifecycle.
* Independently analyze a player or product problem and recommend potential solutions.
* Contribute to at least one feature, event, experiment, or product improvement from discovery through evaluation.
* Produce clear product documentation that helps cross\-functional teams make decisions.
* Build strong working relationships with product, design, engineering, art, analytics, and other partner teams.


**Sample Internship Projects**
 Depending On The Team’s Priorities, The Intern Will Be Assigned To a Game Team, And They May Work On Projects Such As
   

  

* Creating go\-to\-market strategy for a new game under development
* Analyzing the new player onboarding funnel and recommending improvements.
* Conducting a competitive review of progression or social systems.
* Identifying causes of player churn within a specific segment

jobs.description:
Overview:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.  

Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
Responsibilities:
**Senior Analyst \- APM \& IT Service Management**  

AMD is seeking an experienced Senior IT Analyst to drive **end\-to\-end governance of business applications, IT services, and related operational processes** across the organization. This role extends beyond Application Portfolio Management (APM) to include **broader IT Service Management responsibilities (e.g., Change Management, IT Asset Management)** and **AI\-enabled operational improvements**.  

The role requires strong ownership in ensuring **data accuracy, lifecycle governance, and compliance**, while proactively identifying opportunities to **leverage automation and AI\-driven capabilities** aligned with AMD’s enterprise AI strategy.

  



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

 **Application \& Service Governance (Core APM Scope)**

* Manage the **Application Portfolio Management (APM) platform in ServiceNow**, including oversight of APM support and day\-to\-day operations
* Maintain and govern the **inventory of business applications, business and technical services, and service offerings**, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance across all records
* Oversee **end\-to\-end lifecycle management** of applications, including onboarding, updates, ownership changes, and decommissioning
* Initiate and drive **periodic reviews of Business Applications, Services, and Server Mappings** to ensure data integrity, audit readiness, and correct relationships
* Act as **governance approver** for Business Application, Business/Technical Service, Service Offering, and Application Service (Register) requests, ensuring adherence to standards
* Engage with requestors and existing IT Owners to **determine the appropriate structure, classification, and capture of applications and related services**
* Apply **working knowledge of IT organizational structure, enterprise architecture, and service relationships** to ensure correct ownership alignment and modeling
* Proactively monitor **organizational changes (e.g., role transitions, terminations)** and drive timely reassignment of application and service ownership
* Manage the **portfolio of APM\-related service requests**, ensuring timely processing, quality review, and driving **self\-service and process efficiency improvements where appropriate**

 **Broader IT Service Management Responsibilities**

* Support governance and process execution across ITSM domains including **Change Management and IT Asset Management**
* Ensure **proper tracking, accountability, and lifecycle visibility** of assets and services across systems of record
* Drive **process simplification, standardization, governance adherence, and audit readiness** across IT operational workflows
* Identify and implement improvements to **streamline approvals, reduce manual effort, and improve process efficiency**

**AI \& Automation Enablement (Key Differentiator)**

* Identify and drive opportunities to **leverage AI and automation** to enhance APM and ITSM processes (e.g., workflow automation, data insights, intelligent recommendations)
* Support development of **AI\-ready data foundations** by improving data quality, structure, and completeness across applications and service records
* Promote an **AI\-first mindset**, enabling data\-driven decision\-making across application governance, change risk, and asset lifecycle management
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to align with **AMD’s enterprise AI strategy and initiatives**

 **Stakeholder \& Operational Leadership**

* Engage cross\-functionally with Business, IT Business Partners, and Operations teams to **drive governance alignment and accountability**
* Manage APM and related service request queues to ensure **timeliness, quality, and clear communication**
* Proactively identify and address **ownership gaps due to organizational changes or role transitions**

jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Scrum Master to join our growing Technology team, supporting two of our General Insurance development squads based in Hyderabad. You will work across a combination of new development, maintenance, and support \- spanning the full product lifecycle from concept and system design through to live deployment in the cloud.
  

The two squads you will support are drawn from:
  

* COA – Claims Outcome Adviser
* IVI – Intelligent Vehicle Inspection
* AIS – Automated Insurance Solutions
* Property UK
As Scrum Master, your primary role is to protect your squads and keep them focused. You will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, coach teams on Scrum values and practices, and work closely with Product Owners and stakeholders to keep backlogs healthy and delivery on track. These squads are building innovative SaaS products for the insurance industry — used by insurers, suppliers, and regulators across the UK.


  
Key Responsibilities
  

Ceremony Facilitation \& Team Focus
  

* Plan, facilitate, and follow up on all Scrum ceremonies for your squads — daily stand \- ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions.
* Protect the team from outside distractions and scope creep during sprints, maintaining a focused and productive working environment.
* Ensure retrospectives are meaningful and that agreed actions are tracked and followed through, driving genuine continuous improvement.
* Adapt facilitation style to the needs of each squad — recognising that COA, IVI, AIS, and Property UK each have distinct delivery contexts and stakeholder landscapes.
Backlog Management \& Release Planning
  

* Work closely with Product Owners to ensure the backlog is well \- maintained, prioritised, and that stories are fully refined and ready for development before sprint commitment.
* Support release planning and sprint scheduling, helping Product Owners and stakeholders understand team capacity and realistic delivery timelines.
* Flag risks and dependencies early, facilitating cross \- squad or cross \- team coordination where needed — particularly where IVI, COA, AIS, or Property UK work intersects.
* Maintain accurate and up \- to \- date work boards in Azure DevOps / JIRA, ensuring cards move through the process efficiently and blockers are visible and actioned.
Impediment Removal \& Continuous Improvement
  

* Proactively identify and remove impediments — whether technical, organisational, or interpersonal — that slow team progress or threaten sprint goals.
* Track and report key team metrics including velocity, focus factor, and sprint burndown, using data to identify trends and support informed delivery decisions.
* Coordinate with other Scrum Masters across the engineering function when cross \- squad dependencies or shared platform needs arise.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Agile practices across the wider team, sharing learnings and good practice between squads.
Agile Coaching \& Advocacy
  

* Coach squad members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum theory, and the value of iterative delivery.
* Champion a culture of transparency, inspection, and adaptation — helping the teams embrace the spirit of Agile, not just the mechanics.
* Support the onboarding of new team members into Agile ways of working, ensuring they understand ceremonies, roles, and expectations from day one.
* Act as a visible advocate for Agile best practices within the broader Hyderabad engineering community.
Stakeholder Communication \& Collaboration
  

* Maintain clear, timely communication with Product Owners, the Tech Lead, and other stakeholders regarding squad progress, risks, and blockers.
* Work collaboratively with product management to align on development priorities, card readiness, and release timelines across both squads.
* Produce or contribute to sprint and delivery reporting as required, supporting visibility for UK \- based counterparts and senior stakeholders.

  
Essential Requirements
  

* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM I, or equivalent) and/or 3\+ years of hands \- on Scrum Master experience in a software delivery environment.
* Strong knowledge of Agile methodology and frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, with a solid understanding of iterative and incremental development.
* Demonstrable experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and managing backlogs in a commercial product development setting.
* Confident communicator and facilitator, able to engage effectively with developers, product managers, and senior stakeholders alike.
* Strong organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple teams simultaneously.
* Proven ability to identify and resolve impediments, manage conflict constructively, and keep teams on track under pressure.
* Proficient in Agile tooling, particularly Azure DevOps and/or JIRA and Confluence; comfortable with MS Office for reporting and documentation.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of outcomes without close supervision.
Desirable

This role drives effective Scrum execution across geographically distributed teams, collaborates with business stakeholders to convert demand into clear requirements and user stories, and partners with Product, Platform, and Engineering teams to deliver predictable, high\-quality outcomes while maintaining platform health and enterprise standards.
   

  

 This role serves as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders, working closely with ServiceNow Product Owners, Platform teams, and Delivery partners to ensure business demand is clearly articulated and well\-prioritized. It ensures delivered outcomes drive measurable business value while maintaining the long\-term health, integrity, and strategic alignment of the ServiceNow platform and enterprise standards.

* Delivery, Release \& Stakeholder Coordination: Support delivery from intake through UAT, release readiness, and deployment by coordinating resources, schedules, code movement, scope, dependencies, validation activities, risks, metrics, dashboards, and transparent stakeholder communications.
* Continuous Improvement, Governance \& Controls: Document current\- and future\-state workflows, identify opportunities to streamline and standardize processes using ServiceNow, encourage feedback and continuous learning, strengthen intake and requirement practices, and proactively monitor and escalate risks and controls.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 8\+ years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience


**Talents Needed For Success**

***Preferred**** Experience with financial markets, trading systems, or clearing operations.

**Education Qualifications**

* High School Diploma required
* Bachelor's Degree preferred

 **Experience Qualifications**

* Typically \< 2 years required
* Experience and exposure to the Professional Employer Organization (PEO) business model preferred
* Experience working in a public company with exposure to SOX controls and procedures preferred

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to communicate with employees at all levels of the organization
* Ability to build consensus among cross\-functional team members
* A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace
* Ability to adapt to a fast paced continually changing business and work environment while managing multiple priorities
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite with emphasis on Excel
* Knowledge of Salesforce.com, Essbase, SQL, Tableau or other business intelligence systems a plus

### **Description**

  

Product Operations manages Jira Cloud for nearly 10,000 users across Product and Development at Infor. The platform team needs someone to take on routine administration and user support so senior staff can focus on architecture and strategy. This is a learning\-heavy role — you'll be trained on enterprise Atlassian administration while handling the daily operational work that keeps the platform running smoothly.  

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Respond to user support requests — access issues, permission questions, project configuration help, and general "how do I do this in Jira?" inquiries
* Manage user accounts and group memberships following established procedures
* Create and configure Jira projects using existing templates and permission schemes
* Monitor and triage automation rule failures; fix straightforward issues and escalate complex ones
* Create/Maintain documentation — update runbooks, how\-to guides, and internal knowledge base articles as processes change
* Run recurring platform hygiene tasks from checklists (deactivating inactive users, archiving old projects, cleaning up unused schemes)
* Assist senior analysts with testing during platform changes, migrations, or new feature rollouts
* Track and report on support request volume, resolution times, and common issue patterns
* Participate in Atlassian product release reviews to stay current on platform changes
* Work effectively as part of a small, high\-impact team, maintaining ongoing communication and collaboration to prioritize work, share context, and ensure platform support and strategic initiatives stay aligned

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 1\-2 years in an IT support, helpdesk, or systems administration role
* Ability to follow documented procedures accurately and consistently
* Willingness to learn — you don't need to know Atlassian administration yet, but you need to pick it up quickly
* Interest in automation and process improvement
* Clear written communication for support responses and documentation
* Comfort asking questions and knowing when to escalate

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Any hands\-on Atlassian administration or user experience (even personal or small\-team instances)

jobs.title: Business Analyst (Healthcare Claims)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong domain expertise in Indian Healthcare Claims. The ideal candidate should be capable of translating business needs into clear technical requirements, acting as a bridge between business stakeholders, development, and QA teams, and ensuring successful delivery through strong documentation, analysis, and communication skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements, translating them into detailed functional and technical specifications
* Work closely with clients to understand explicit and implicit requirements, effectively capturing unspoken needs and converting them into actionable requirements
* Act as a bridge between business, technical, and QA teams to ensure clear understanding and alignment across all stakeholders
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including BRD, FRD, user stories, and process flows
* Develop diagrams such as process flow diagrams, sequence diagrams, high\-level system architecture, and module\-level designs to aid understanding
* Define and maintain a Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) with proper numbering, ensuring mapping of requirements to features, tasks, and test cases
* Collaborate with QA teams to define UAT acceptance criteria and ensure test coverage aligns with business requirements
* Define and enforce Definition of Done (DoD) for features and tasks to ensure completeness and quality
* Participate in requirement walkthroughs, sprint planning, and review sessions to ensure clarity and completeness
* Support UAT phases by coordinating with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, and ensuring successful sign\-off



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong experience as a Business Analyst in Indian Healthcare Claims domain
* Excellent documentation skills, including BRD, FRD, and user story creation
* Ability to convert business requirements into technical requirements with clarity
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Experience in creating diagrams (process flows, sequence diagrams, system flows, module diagrams)
* Hands\-on experience with requirement traceability and test alignment (RTM)
* Experience in defining UAT acceptance criteria and ensuring requirement completeness



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with design and prototyping tools like Figma
* Basic understanding of system architecture and APIs



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Ability to understand implicit client needs
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

jobs.description:
**Some careers have more impact than others.**


If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Assistant Vice President Marketing**

**Purpose of the role**


The Global Marketing function is focused on supporting the strategic and revenue growth priorities of the Bank. The function focuses on understanding customers and the identification, development and execution of marketing strategies, campaigns and activities that support and strengthen the HSBC brand, support the drive for revenue, and increase customer value and satisfaction in order to meet agreed targets and objectives at both a global and market level.


This role is part of the Asset Management Marketing \& Client Experience team where the candidate will be Benguluru\-based, and part of Marketing Center of Excellence for Asset Management, while the role primarily supports institutional and product capabilities, you will be required to work across the spectrum of solutions and Products in the HSBC Asset Management business, as required.


This role is responsible for the implementation of Asset Management global initiatives that requires strong project management skills, a passion for accuracy, a focus on attention to detail, and an ability to operate systems. This role forms part of a dynamic team that spans the delivery of global marketing plans.

**In this role, you will be:**

* Own cross\-border marketing content by partnering with investment specialists, portfolio managers, compliance and other teams to support assets under management growth through strong internal and external\-facing materials.
* Plan and drive end\-to\-end delivery of high\-quality marketing materials for investment products and mandates, including literature, presentations, videos and digital campaigns, with ongoing updates and governance.

* Increase visibility of key investment capabilities by working closely with investment specialists and portfolio managers and supporting engagement with clients and internal stakeholders.

* Maintain strong controls, teamwork and culture by addressing compliance feedback promptly and maintaining proper logs for audit purposes, recognising gaps and driving process improvements to improve service level agreements, following agreed processes and controls to spot and reduce risks and escalating control or reputational issues quickly when needed; operate as an individual contributor who is a flexible team player able to work across teams on cross\-functional projects, support achievement of the HSBC vision, values, goals and culture in personal behaviour, actions and decision making, help agencies and partners understand HSBC values while developing initiatives, and work collaboratively within marketing and proposition teams.

**To be successful you will be:**

* Post\-graduation in marketing or finance.
* Around 8 years of experience in the marketing space within asset management or a similar financial services company, with product marketing experience compulsory.
* Strong understanding of the asset management industry, including investment products, investment capabilities and asset classes.
* Ability to work through complex processes and procedures, with experience of working in a regulated industry and adhering to complex procedures and processes.
* Strong project management capability to move initiatives forward in a cross\-functional and matrixed operations organisational model, with a flexible and proactive attitude to respond effectively to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Design\-oriented approach to build compelling slides and other marketing materials, keeping end users and the audience in mind; supported by very good presentation skills and the ability to depict complexity and support a thesis.
* Marketing technology and digital capability, including experience with SharePoint, Seismic preferred, a basic level of knowledge in digital marketing, and experience using Artificial Intelligence tools preferred.
* Strong collaboration and people skills, including being a proven team player able to work with globally distributed teams and influence across multiple teams, communicate clearly and accurately with stakeholders, partners and colleagues, and demonstrate strong interpersonal and people management capabilities; self\-starter who can work collaboratively, influence and motivate others, and thrive in a diverse work environment.

jobs.description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI\-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud\-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.


We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to join our global Lodging Distribution team, where innovation knows no borders. This team shapes business\-to\-business (B2B) travel distribution by delivering high\-scale Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and artificial intelligence (AI) enabled tools to global travel agencies. We connect suppliers with advertisers to unlock new monetization channels. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.


As a Lead Product Manager, you will own product strategy for our B2B hotel distribution platform to drive high\-impact growth. You will scale intelligent systems, guide engineering teams and launch next\-generation workflows. This role requires technical grounding, business acumen and the confidence to challenge legacy frameworks.


**What you'll do**

* Lead product strategy to scale lodging AI systems and onboard global travel agencies.
* Launch a new media product by designing optimal pricing and inventory controls.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to prioritize requirements and manage backlogs effectively.
* Partner with commercial stakeholders to execute Go\-to\-Market strategies that create customer value.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Customer Incentives and Growth Platforms
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting).
* Experience in customer incentive platforms, promotional engines, loyalty/rewards systems, billing/fintech, growth engineering, or business generation mechanics.
* Experience managing ambiguity, proactively anticipating technical or operational roadblocks, and turning complex platform constraints into seamless customer experiences.
* Practical proficiency in leveraging generative AI tools and agents for deep product research, market synthesis, user journey mapping, and rapid feature prototyping.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


As a Product Manager on the Incentives and Growth Platforms team, you will own the end\-to\-end product goal, technical strategy, and execution for core customer incentive and reward charters across the customer lifecycle. You will manage complex challenges at the intersection of behavioral economics, growth engineering, conversational AI, recommendation engines, partner platforms, and fraud/risk. This is a high\-visibility role where you require strong product instincts, technical depth, and the ability to rally cross\-functional stakeholders (Engineering, UX, Product Marketing, Data Science, Operations, and Risk) around a clear product point of view and infrastructure.


Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting\-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi\-billion dollar global business.


Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return\-on\-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state\-of\-the\-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the central product leader uniting cross\-functional partners—including Software Engineering, UX/Design, Product Marketing, Customer Operations, Data Science, and Trust and Safety/Risk.
* Lead the proactive use of AI tools and reasoning models to conduct deep quantitative and market research, analyze user journeys, test behavioral hypotheses, and rapidly prototype novel incentive mechanics and conversational workflows.
* Own the multi\-quarter strategy and technical roadmap for core customer incentive and reward charters, aligning product bets with broader business growth, customer retaining, and payback goals.
* Design robust MCP tool schemas and API interfaces that empower autonomous agents and conversational assistants to deliver personalized promotional recommendations.
* Design and execute rigorous A/B testing and flighting strategies to evaluate hypotheses, measure causal incrementality, and analyze redemption vs. breakage economics.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

The Credit \& Loan Servicing Manager – Associate plays a crucial role in the Loans group, responsible for delivering on key operational tasks and driving excellence. This position offers valuable exposure to a wide range of banking processes, contributing to the seamless operation and success of our financial services. Join our dynamic team to make a significant impact and support our clients in a collaborative environment.

As a Credit \& Loan Servicing Manager – Associate within the Loans group, you will be responsible for closely monitoring and guiding your team to ensure all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are consistently met. You will oversee a variety of processes, including Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, Pre\-payments, Funding, Rate\-Fixings, Fees, and external payments. This role offers a unique opportunity to enhance your skills in managing Nostro \& Past Due Reconciliation and make a significant impact on our operations.

* Monitor the team daily to ensure all SLAs are met and escalate exceptions immediately for resolution.
* Supervise processes such as Deal Closing, Drawdowns, Rollovers, Repayments, and Nostro \& Past Due Reconciliation.

* Hold a Bachelor's degree with minimum 8 years of relevant experience in credit support or loan servicing, ideally in syndicated loans or financial industry roles.

* Demonstrate strong problem\-solving and investigative skills to analyze and resolve process\-related issues.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
 WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
   

  

 We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**About WisdomAI**
 WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data\-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup, currently \~30 people and growing.
   

  

**The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor**
 This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands\-on function built for the age of AI\-native product development. We are a build\-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.
   

  

 At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4\+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
 The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.
   

  

* Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
* Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context.
* Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team.
* Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions.
* Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer\-facing teams.
* Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
* Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM\-first, Design\-first, or Dev\-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform.
* Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals.
* Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch.
* Work effectively in our fast\-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long\-term strategic goals.
* Strategic Communication
* Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization.
* Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value.
* Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process.


**What You'll Bring: Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI\-native platforms.
* Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade\-offs with customers and engineers.
* Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** 
 We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide.
   

  

**T — Transparency.** 
 We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer**
 WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

 The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI\-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI\-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.
   

  

 The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).

We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero\-carbon future.
   

  

 Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150\+ energy\-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

jobs.description:
Overview:
**About the company**


Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory \& transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost\-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise.

**Job Summary**  

Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products — often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high\-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.  

We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi\-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.
This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built. **How this role operates**  

You'll partner with Product and Engineering early — shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.
Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.
Responsibilities:
* Own end\-to\-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post\-launch iteration
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements
* Translate in\-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns
* Define the interaction models for AI\-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it
* Evolve and maintain Consilio's design system — defining components and patterns, and setting the standards for how they're used
* Build accessibility standards into the system rather than retrofitting it
* Prototype rapidly to explore, align, and de\-risk decisions using modern AI tools
* Lead or partner on user research, and turn findings into decisions other people can act on
* Make the case for design decisions and system standards to senior stakeholders through evidence and clear storytelling


Qualifications:* 8\+ years designing complex enterprise or B2B software, with shipped work you can walk us through
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a multi\-product environment — not just consuming one
* Experience designing end\-to\-end journeys for multi product ecosystems
* Experience with Figma Make, or other similar prompt\-based prototyping tools.
* Depth in interaction design, with visual craft strong enough to make the work persuasive
* Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering from problem definition forward
* Bachelor’s degree in Design (e.g., Interaction, Visual, Industrial Design), HCI, or equivalent practical experience.

 **Qualities we're looking for*** Systems thinking. You design for scale and consistency by default, not as a cleanup pass.
* Standards judgment. You know when to generalize a pattern and when a one\-off is the right answer — and you can say no to a component request without damaging the relationship.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You can make a defensible tradeoff without perfect information, and revisit it when better information arrives.
* Influence without authority. You change what gets built by being persuasive and well\-reasoned, not by escalating.
* Clarity under complexity. You can take a genuinely complicated workflow and make it feel obvious.

 **Portfolio*** Strong portfolio demonstrating complex workflow design across multiple web\-based enterprise products.
* Work samples that showcase prototyping ability.

  

Nice to have* Experience with AI driven products or designing AI powered interactions
* Formal or self\-directed learning in AI/ML concepts
* Prior experience designing for legal, compliance, healthcare, financial services, or another high\-consequence regulated domain.

 **Why Join Us:**

* Be part of a collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Opportunity for professional growth and development.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Contribute to shaping the future of our software development processes.

 **Consilio’s True North Values**

* Client Experience \| Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
* Collaboration \| Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
* Innovation \| Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
* Grit \| Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Aerchain (Why Us?)
 



  





 We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI\-first platform that powers $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
 



  





 From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise\-grade, AI\-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own a cluster of modules and be accountable for the outcomes they drive across customers. You’ll work with enterprise clients to ensure they realise value from the product, lead solutioning for complex accounts, define what the cluster builds and why, and ensure every module delivers measurable customer value. You’ll work across business, engineering, and leadership, and develop the PMs / Builders in your cluster. You set the
 



 standard for how the cluster builds: solutions are prototyped in AI, and engineering builds forward from those prototypes rather than from a blank page. You report to the Product Lead.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own one or more modules end\-to\-end, not just the backlog, but the customer outcomes those modules drive. You’ll run customer engagements independently, work closely with business and engineering teams, and be the single point of authority for what gets built, deferred, and why. You don’t take requirements; you diagnose problems and prescribe solutions. You don’t just spec the build; you start it: you prototype the solution in AI, and engineering builds forward from what you’ve made rather than from a blank page. You report to a Principal PM / Lead Builder or a Senior PM / Senior Builder.
 



  





 What You’ll Drive
 



  





 Problem Discovery \& Research
 



  




* Own customer engagements end\-to\-end: understand their problems, workflows, and success criteria well enough to prescribe, not just specify.
* Analyse data and signals to validate and size problems. Know the problem better than the customer does.
* Zero escalations without a recommended path and supporting reasoning.



  





 Customer Ownership
 



  




* Own Tier B or Tier C customer engagements end\-to\-end, from understanding their problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
* Solution customers independently, coordinating with other PMs / Builders where modules overlap.
* Be the single point of contact for your customers, not just during delivery, but through adoption and outcome validation.



  





 Solutioning \& Prototyping
 



  




* Define what gets built, deferred, and killed, with reasoning tied to customer outcomes, not stakeholder volume.
* Write PRDs that engineering can build from without constant clarification: scenarios, edge cases, and acceptance criteria all present before grooming.
* Build working prototypes in AI, not throwaway mockups. Your prototype is the foundation engineering builds forward from: developers extend the backend, harden it, and refine functionality from what you’ve already built. A large part of the build happens in your hands.
* Use AI across every step: research, problem framing, drafting, prototyping, validation.



  





 Execution \& Delivery
 



  




* Own sprint delivery for your modules. Coordinate across engineering and business teams. Unblock issues before they become delays.
* Ensure milestone testing and validation happens before release. Own the quality bar for your modules.



  





 Release \& Adoption
 



  




* Define and track customer\-value metrics for your modules, metrics that answer: is this module making procurement measurably better?
* Own post\-release adoption. A shipped feature with no adoption is a failure you own.



  





 You’ll thrive here if
 



  




* 4–6 years in product roles with demonstrated module or feature ownership.
* You diagnose problems from first principles and prescribe solutions; you don’t take requirements and execute.
* You use AI as a core part of how you work, not occasionally, but across every step of discovery, solutioning, and delivery, including building the prototype engineering carries forward.
* You make decisions in ambiguity with reasoning. You don’t escalate problems, you escalate recommendations.
* You think in outcomes, not outputs. You know the difference between shipping and delivering value.
* Bonus: exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex B2B environments, or procurement tech.



  





 What’s In It For You
 



  




* Full module ownership on a platform that processes $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
* Direct engagement with enterprise customers: you own their outcomes, not just their tickets.
* Work with a team that has chosen to move first on AI: you’ll be operating at a level most product teams won’t reach for years.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded, and the opposite is called out.



  





 Ready to build Aerchain’s future?
 



  





 If reimagining business engines with AI and solving problems at scale excites you, let’s talk. Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

jobs.description:
**About us:** 




 We are a highly successful 190\-year\-old, Fortune 500 commercial property insurance company of 6,000\+ employees with a unique focus on science and risk engineering. Businesses worldwide trust our expertise to protect their assets, relying on our comprehensive risk assessments and robust, engineering\-based insurance solutions to safeguard against fire, natural disasters, and other perils. Serving over a quarter of the Fortune 500 and major corporations globally, we deliver data\-driven strategies that enhance resilience, ensure business continuity, and empower organizations to thrive.
 



 FM India is a strategic location for driving our global operational efficiency. Our presence in India allows us to leverage the country’s talented workforce and advance our capabilities to serve our clients better. We have diverse corporate functions that emphasize research, advanced technologies like AI and analytics, risk engineering, research, finance, marketing, HR, etc. working together to provide innovative solutions and nurture lasting relationships – from co\-workers to clients.
 



  





**Role Title: Sr Business Analyst** 




**Position Summary:** 




 The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for the collection, evaluation, understanding, and communication of business requirements involved in the development of new or the modification and ongoing support of existing enterprise business applications. This position is the second of four levels within the Business Analysis job family.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 



* Participates in system requirements definition, testing, training, implementation, and support of enterprise\-wide business applications.
* Solicits business requirements through interviews, workshops, and/or existing system documentation or procedures. Uses industry standard analysis techniques to uncover business requirements, such as data flow modeling, use\-case analysis, and workflow analysis.
* Documents the results of analysis activities using the appropriate templates and tools.
* Makes recommendations regarding necessary changes on deliverables expected from other groups.
* Works with other development groups to ensure an integrated business solution.
* Assumes the responsibility of project manager for projects that are limited in scope and are, generally, modifications to an existing application.
* Demonstrates a clear understanding of FM Global’s business and business processes.

* 3\-5 years of experience required to perform essential job functions.

* TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE \| Strong knowledge of techniques and tools utilized in functional design, data analysis, and data flow diagramming. \| Knowledge of FM Global's current/planned technological environment and the appropriate technologies, tools, and techniques used to solve business problems.
* TECHNICAL SKILLS \| Experience gathering requirements, functional design, and working with business processes. \| Proven ability to work in technical environments that use tools involved in data flow diagramming, data analysis, issue tracking, and documentation and presentation.

Ensures business processes align with platform capabilities, operational constraints, and enterprise standards.
* Requirements Translation to Sitecore Capabilities – Proven skill translating marketing and business requirements into Sitecore\-specific constructs such as templates, components, content structures, personalization rules, workflows, publishing models, search configurations, and integration touchpoints. Partners closely with engineering to ensure requirements are clear, testable, and aligned to Sitecore best practices.

* Content Governance \& Operating Model Support – Strong understanding of enterprise content lifecycle governance, including authoring standards, publishing controls, versioning, archival, and operational practices. jobs.description:
**About Us**
 At ANZ, we're applying new ways technology and data can be harnessed as we work towards a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Business Analyst** 
 in the Tech Pacific Domain, you are responsible for leading business analysis activities across complex projects, ensuring business objectives are effectively translated into robust technical solutions, and managing teams to deliver successful outcomes.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Purpose** 
 :
   

  

* To use analytical and communication skills to elicit, understand, validate and document requirements for business issues, functions and processes from high\-level business needs through to detailed solution requirements.
* The role plays a key role in supporting the delivery of solutions through the SDLC and in Agile delivery methodologies.
* The Business Analyst may work independently or in a scrum environment on small/ low complexity changes; with guidance as part of BA team on low\-medium complexity components of larger initiatives.


**Role Type** 
 : Permanent
   

  

**Work Location** 
 : Bengaluru
   

  

**Work Schedule** 
 : Regular Shifts(Hybrid\\Blended)
   

  

**What will your day look like?**
 As a Business Analyst, you are accountable for:
   

  

**Analysis** 
 :
   

  

* Elicitation – define and refine requirements
* Analysis and Problem Solving
* Process Mapping – current \& target state
* Identify dependencies/risks and issues
* Use of Stories/Acceptance Criteria
* Building Domain/Application Knowledge


**Deliver** 
 :
   

  

* Self\-Managing – deliver to outcomes as agreed
* Good communication \& documentation
* Responds to and invites feedback
* Facilitation Skills – team based
* Learning ANZ release processes/ADF
* Learning Agile Ways of Working


**Connect** 
 :
   

  

* Support team/colleagues \| Develop relationships \| Attends and learns in Guilds/CoPs


**Lead** 
 :
   

  

* Provide and receive feedback \| Share knowledge \| Support colleagues wellbeing


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* 10\+ years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst with a good understanding in Banking Domain.
* As a Business Analyst have you supported or delivered an end\-to\-end mobile platform project for iOS \& Android.
* Lead and manage the end\-to\-end gathering and analysis of business and technical requirements.
* Collaborate with developers, testers, project managers, and business stakeholders to define and validate technical solutions.
* Analyze business and stakeholders need to define detailed functional and non\-functional requirements that support solution design and development.
* Translate business objectives into actionable system capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, compliance, and banking regulations.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of banking products, services, and the regulatory environment.
* Prepare comprehensive documentation, including use cases, prototypes, and technical specifications.
* Facilitate workshops and discussions with internal teams and stakeholders to elicit and refine requirements.
* Operate effectively in cross\-functional Agile/Scrum teams, actively participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Act as a key liaison between business and IT teams, ensuring solutions meet user expectations and strategic goals.


**Detailed Description**
* Identify gaps, dependencies, and risks, providing recommendations to improve business processes and technical solutions.
* Maintain traceability of requirements throughout the project lifecycle, supporting test case creation, validation, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline operations and reduce manual effort.
* Build and manage strong stakeholder relationships, demonstrating effective communication and influence at senior levels.


**Technical Took Kit** 
 : Candidates are expected to demonstrate proficiency in at least one of the following technical areas
   

  

* Good Knowledge of programming and scripting, with practical experience in Python, Java, and basic JavaScript, API testing tools (Postman, Swagger)
* Good Knowledge on Cloud, Integration, Version Control, Devops \& Testing
* Requirements Management \& Collaboration: JIRA, Confluence, IBM DOORS, Trello, Asana
* Process Modeling \& Diagramming: BPMN tools (Bizagi, Camunda), UML tools (Enterprise Architect, Lucidchart, Visio), Wireframing tools (Balsamiq, Figma)
* Data Analysis \& Visualization: SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server), Tableau, Power BI, Excel (advanced), Python (data analysis), Jupyter Notebook


**So why join us?**
 ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
